stem:
A teacher used an electric kettle filled with water to demonstrate the water cycle to students. The image shows the setup for this demonstration.

Which of these identifies how a stage of the water cycle is represented in the demonstration?

options.label: A
options.text: Runoff: Water droplets appeared on the plate.

options.label: B
options.text: Condensation: Water droplets fell from the plate.

options.label: C
options.text: Evaporation: The amount of water in the kettle decreased.

options.label: D
options.text: Precipitation: The water in the kettle began to boil.

visual_elements: Electric kettle plugged into an outlet on a counter
Hand wearing oven mitt holding a plate above the kettle
